model_annotation: Both panels present training reward as a function of training steps for two methods, with the x-axis labeled “Steps” on a linear scale spanning 0 to 500 and showing regularly spaced tick labels at 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, and 500. In the top panel titled “Easy Training Set,” the y-axis is labeled “Training Rewards” on a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.4 with visible ticks at 0.0, 0.2, and 0.4; it contains two solid lines with semi-transparent bands of the same colors around them: a blue line labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” that starts near 0.0 at step 0, rises to a local high a little above 0.1 around roughly 100–150 steps, and then trends downward with oscillations, ending around the high 0.0x range (roughly ~0.07–0.09) by step 500, and a red line labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Easy” that also begins near 0.0, increases to around ~0.1 near roughly the first 100 steps, then gradually declines with frequent small fluctuations while remaining above the blue curve late in training, finishing around ~0.11–0.13 at step 500. In the bottom panel titled “Hard Training Set,” the y-axis is labeled “Training Rewards” on a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.2 with visible ticks at 0.0, 0.1, and 0.2; it shows a blue solid line labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” that starts near 0.0 and quickly drops below the 0.0 baseline within the first portion of the x-range, after which it remains near a flat, slightly negative level through to step 500, and a red solid line labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Hard” (with a matching semi-transparent band) that begins near 0.0, rises to a small early peak around ~0.05–0.06 near approximately 50–100 steps, then exhibits repeated oscillations while gradually decreasing toward values closer to 0.0 by roughly the mid-to-late steps, and ends with a small positive value around a few hundredths (approximately ~0.02–0.03) by step 500.
